brief:
Israeli forces conducted widespread invasions across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem early Wednesday, detaining Palestinians and breaking into homes, IMEMC News reported. The operations included demolitions of residential buildings, commercial shops, agricultural structures, and greenhouses across multiple areas.

The raids unfolded simultaneously in several locations throughout the territory. The military operations targeted both urban and rural areas, affecting civilian property and infrastructure. Israeli forces also ransacked homes during the incursions.

Officials have not yet released figures on the total number of Palestinians detained or a comprehensive accounting of the structures destroyed and damaged during the Wednesday operations.
